deployments_detail.use: Orva: voice-AI assistant purpose-built for the operating room (hands-free surgical charting, event logging, care-team coordination, ICD-10/CPT coding), to be brought to francophone-Africa healthcare facilities via the Rain Stella x Vicenne alliance announced at WHX Future X Stage. Orva uses proprietary surgical-tuned speech and LLM services. Partnership is announced/planned, not yet shown deployed on a site. [Rain Stella Technologies (Orva)]

Equinox: cloud-based, AI-driven electronic medical record (EMR) system that centralizes and secures patient data, to be deployed across francophone Africa through the Vicenne x Rain Stella alliance. Supports multi-specialty documentation and care coordination. [Rain Stella Technologies (Equinox)]

Constellation: FHIR-based health information exchange (HIE) / data-sharing platform for practitioner coordination and national interoperability, part of the AI-driven healthcare stack Vicenne intends to deploy across francophone Africa with Rain Stella. [Rain Stella Technologies (Constellation)]

Vicenne's stated technology strategy (presented by DGA Sanaa Deraoui at GITEX Future Health Africa Morocco, May 2026): developing and integrating AI-based tools designed to improve access to medical information and accelerate healthcare professionals' decision-making, across imaging, biology, cardiology and IT-solutions segments, while keeping the physician central to diagnosis/treatment. Framed as strategy/direction rather than a documented live deployment. [none named]
